grouping: one manufactured family per network (power tray/cable; lane conveyor). Repeated pieces share the family bill.
componentReferenceDecisionWhy: Construction is taken from cited industrial cable-tray, SWA, roller-conveyor and gland practice plus the locked works mask/section. No generated whole-asset image is used as identity.

power.oneSentenceRead: A bolted ladder tray carrying one gold-jacketed armoured cable, lit only at a recessed contact.

zones.substrate: hot-dip galvanized formed steel channel, IEC 61537 ladder class
extruded LSZH polymer jacket over SWA, restrained brass-gold pigment — identification, not a light
helical galvanized steel wires under the jacket, visible at clamps and glands as banding
forbidden: painted rings as the only armour

zones.substrate: pressed steel saddle + two flange bolts into the rungs, rooted on the tray
forbidden: rings that do not touch the tray

zones.substrate: recessed copper-beryllium slot in a clamp window or gland face; the only legal emissive
nickel-plated brass glands (IEC 62444), folded steel lid, L-brackets to the mount

lane.oneSentenceRead: A framed roller conveyor: two C-channel rails, a narrow belt on roller crowns, hollow under the bed, a smoked cover strip, and a real service lid / gearmotor where the fitting needs one.

zones.substrate: folded painted steel C-section rails with sparse bolted cross-sleepers, dark industrial enamel over zinc
zinc-plated steel tubes on through-axles in rail bosses (CEMA / MDR practice)
dark rubber belt with transverse cleats sitting on the roller crowns; this is flow_mesh
narrow polycarbonate wear strip over the product path only; rollers and rails stay visible beside it
gearmotor stub at junction, L-brackets to the mount, axle keepers

atlas.normal: tangent, OpenGL, mesh-derived plus role microstructure
atlas.emission: basecolor alpha drives Principled emission strength; only powered contact is non-zero
